variants.name: chosen-list
variants.why: My day also lists the chosen sessions, each with its own Remove, so a chosen title is rendered twice and stays visible under a filter that hides its programme row.

variants.name: conflict-disabled-with-note
variants.why: A session whose slot is taken cannot be clicked: its control is disabled and renamed Unavailable, and its row explains the conflict.

variants.name: filter-select
variants.why: All, Morning and Afternoon are the options of one select instead of three buttons.

variants.name: title-inside-action-names
variants.why: The accessible names put the title inside the action: Add Sound walks to my day.

variants.name: dialog-plain-lines
variants.why: Each entry of the dialog is one text, 10:00 — Sound walks, so no element holds the bare title.

variants.name: other-wording
variants.why: The dialog button carries the number of chosen sessions, Review my day (2); the refusal says 10:00 is already taken by Sound walks, the empty day Nothing chosen yet, and the finish line starts with Demo finished.

variants.name: titles-in-button-text
variants.why: The buttons end with the title in a visually hidden element (Add to my day Sound walks), and each entry of the dialog has its own Remove, so the bare title is rendered twice in a row.
